sources.title: Michael Kumhof, Ricardo Nunes and Irina Yakadina, Simple Monetary Rules Under Fiscal Dominance
sources.use: Joint monetary/fiscal closure and separation of determinacy, feasibility and welfare. The chapter derives an original deterministic endowment example, not this paper’s quantitative model.
sources.verification: Actual official HTML abstract and introduction lines17–51 and model/rule discussion52–169 inspected. Source is IFDP937, July2008, not current policy guidance.
sources.limits: No quantitative replication, figure reading or general empirical endorsement. No source code or exercises copied.

sources.title: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Default Risk and Income Fluctuations
sources.use: Specialist recursive sovereign borrowing/default and risk-neutral creditor pricing context for an original finite-horizon exact model.
sources.verification: Actual author-maintained HTML sections3.1–3.3.1, lines50–265, read. Computation opening266–299 inspected only to distinguish a numerical iteration from an equilibrium existence proof.
sources.limits: No source calibration/code/historical findings reproduced; finite-horizon absorbing-exclusion model is original and differs from source re-entry/infinite-horizon domain. No installed source libraries or screenshots claimed.
